summary: BLUT/Katana process adapters and the core enrollment codec are merged. Candidate additions provide current-policy authority admission, cryptographic collector verification, actual-account protected store loading, operator activation with retained selection history, and fresh checks per use. This branch adds approved-image SHA256 observation and sealed Linux execution; two unit controls and a two-account path-replacement control pass. Hosted integration, native adapter wiring, authenticated caller identity, dynamic dependencies, launch/revocation fencing, operator deployment and independent/participant qualification remain open. A retained-capability bypass of real-UID authority write checks was reproduced and repaired using effective-permission observations; the same namespace worker is now refused.
next_steps: Finish protected enrollment drafting/signing and native collector workflow wiring; selected configuration does not authenticate the acting collector or fence a native launch.
Wire trusted collector policy and native verifier into the actual workflow request/response path; preserve UNKNOWN for absent custody, spend or confinement observations.
Complete actual provider integrations, independent verification and participant qualification without inventing acceptance.
